text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Gimlet's amazing...! Forget making a comeback, isn't her running even stronger than it was at the Derby!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I thought Kris S was going to dominate alone, but this generation really belongs to Tanino Gimlet!
Keep giving it your all from here on out, toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh. What needed to be done has been done, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (...Kris S. Just how strong are you planning to become...!?)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(The abyss I glimpsed in today's race.
A chill so deep it made even me break into a cold sweat—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...It seems that even in my new script, you remain an indispensable presence.
The day after the Kobe Shimbun Hai, where she made an impressive show of her comeback to the public—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: “――――So, her next race isn't the Kikuka Sho, but the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!?”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "And there, I will show my strength. A strength so great... it will overwrite... their memories."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Incredible! A declaration to challenge the Autumn Tenno Sho in the Classic class! What could Symboli Kris S's aim be with this announcement—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, surely that shouldn't come as a surprise—
The public buzzed with Tanino Gimlet's dramatic comeback, alongside talk of her rival, Symboli Kris S, entering the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
How do you see Kris S right now?
choice_data_list: ...As always, you truly are an unfathomable existence.

text_block_list.text:
With every race she runs,
Symboli Kris S steadily grows stronger and sharper.

Without a doubt, in this very era,
she is climbing to the ranks of the absolute strongest—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, precisely.
He is now an entity cloaked in unfathomable dread.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...If this continues, she will definitely appear in our target Yasuda-Takarazuka rotation.
As an even greater threat than at the Derby. However—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I have no intention of trembling before it...!
Nor will I sit idly by and wait!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, it's the opposite!! What I must do—
is dive headfirst into the abyss!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —I'm entering the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And let us show the world once more!!
Who commands this moment right now!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What?
...Don't tell me, you—

I showed Tanino Gimlet the set of race entry
documents I had prepared yesterday.

"This was... for the sake of
running in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――Heheh... Hahahaha...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaa-hahahahaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Confound it, I've been completely had...! What was that about a 'bottomless enigma'? What an absolute trickster!
choice_data_list: Anticipating every move—that's the true madness.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Words are no longer needed.
Let us go forth! To proclaim my very existence,
towards the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!!

And so, Tanino Gimlet's next goal
was set for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Now that's a rare sight.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I thought you were someone who questioned your own running
before questioning the whims of heaven, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I just thought...
that I might find you here.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, right according to plan, huh.
You're just like a hunting dog――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...And so?
With such uncharacteristic heat in your words, what are you asking of me?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...This is not—a question.
It is simply—...a confirmation."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...—The Tenno Sho (Autumn).
I heard that Gimlet... is running too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...You have my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bow...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Seeing the completion of your 'MC Rotation'...—
and the frenzy it brought... I—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The way I am now... is not enough, you say—
To fulfill my "mission"... to achieve a "revolution"—
I am falling short, you say—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes—I was able... to realize it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So――……I've decided.
In order to suffice――in order to reach――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“The Tenno Sho (Autumn)—a breakthrough.
...So you're saying it'll serve as a breakthrough.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Without you—
I would surely have been... far weaker.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: So you're saying... you're grateful.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Kukuku...! Haha—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaa-hahahahaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Was something... off, I wonder—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No. There's nothing wrong with you.
If anything――it made me understand all over again.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"That is why we...
are who we are."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "...The Tenno Sho (Autumn). There, I shall thoroughly gauge your true worth."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...Just what I was hoping for.

—Time flows on without pause,
toward the next bloody battle: the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
